name: python-pancake-sort
title: Insertion Minimum Spanning Tree
blurb: pancake sort over small non-negative integers: the sorted list equals the oracle on every seeded instance, the sort is stable, and negative or oversized values are named, never sorted.
default_description: A spanning-tree walker whose total is the enumeration oracle's minimum on every small undirected graph, whose witness ledger tells the truth, and whose tree spans every node exactly once.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the sorted prefix grows one value at a time, walked leftwards
